```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws
import pulumi_kubernetes as k8s

# Retrieve stack configuration
config = pulumi.Config()
env = config.require("environment")  # 'dev' or 'prod'

# Determine environment-specific values
if env == "dev":
    region = "us-east-1"
    node_instance_type = "t3.medium"
    node_count = 2
    rds_instance_type = "db.t3.micro"
    rds_multi_az = False
    rds_encrypted = False
    alb_internal = True
    cloudfront_enabled = False
elif env == "prod":
    region = "us-east-1"
    node_instance_type = "t3.large"
    node_count = 4
    rds_instance_type = "db.t3.medium"
    rds_multi_az = True
    rds_encrypted = True
    alb_internal = False
    cloudfront_enabled = True
else:
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown environment: {env}")

pulumi.export("region", region)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# S3 Bucket
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bucket = aws.s3.Bucket(
    "app-assets",
    bucket= f"app-assets-{env}",
    acl="private",
)

bucket_versioning = aws.s3.BucketVersioning(
    "app-assets-versioning",
    bucket=bucket.id,
    versioning_configuration={
        "status": "Enabled",
    },
)

bucket_encryption = aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration(
    "app-assets-encryption",
    bucket=bucket.id,
    rules=[
        {
            "apply_server_side_encryption_by_default": {
                "sse_algorithm": "aws:kms",
            },
        }
    ],
)

bucket_public_access_block = aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock(
    "app-assets-public-access-block",
    bucket=bucket.id,
    block_public_acls=True,
    block_public_policy=True,
    ignore_public_acls=True,
    restrict_public_buckets=True,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IAM for service account
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
service_account_role_name = f"svc-{env}"

if env == "prod":
    # OIDC trust policy for least-privilege role
    issuer_url = "https://oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE"
    trust_policy = {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
            {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                    "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/eks-oidc-provider"
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {
                    "StringEquals": {
                        f"{issuer_url}:sub": f"system:serviceaccount:default:app-{env}",
                        f"{issuer_url}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                    }
                },
            }
        ],
    }
else:
    # Programmatic access: assume role by EC2 (EKS node)
    trust_policy = {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
            {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                    "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com",
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
            }
        ],
    }

service_account_role = aws.iam.Role(
    "service-account",
    name=service_account_role_name,
    assume_role_policy=pulumi.Output.json.dumps(trust_policy),
)

# Least-privilege policy: no wildcard actions
service_account_policy = aws.iam.Policy(
    "service-account-policy",
    name=f"svc-{env}-policy",
    policy=pulumi.Output.json.dumps({
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
            {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "rds:DescribeDBInstances",
                ],
                "Resource": [
                    f"arn:aws:s3:::app-assets-{env}/*",
                    "arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:123456789012:db:app-db-*",
                ],
            },
        ],
    }),
)

aws.iam.RolePolicyAttachment(
    "service-account-policy-attach",
    role=service_account_role.name,
    policy_arn=service_account_policy.arn,
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RDS PostgreSQL
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
db_subnet_group = aws.rds.SubnetGroup(
    "db-subnet-group",
    name=f"db-subnet-{env}",
    subnet_ids=["subnet-aaa", "subnet-bbb"],  # VPC subnets (example)
)

db_security_group = aws.ec2.SecurityGroup(
    "db-security-group",
    name=f"db-sg-{env}",
    description="RDS PostgreSQL security group",
    egress=[
        {
            "protocol": "-1",
            "from_port": 0,
            "to_port": 0,
            "cidr_blocks": ["0.0.0.0/0"],
        },
    ],
)

db_security_group_ingress = aws.ec2.SecurityGroupIngress(
    "db-security-group-ingress",
    security_group_id=db_security_group.id,
    protocol="tcp",
    from_port=5432,
    to_port=5432,
    cidr_blocks=["10.0.0.0/8"],  # VPC internal range
)

# Get VPC id (assumed existing or created elsewhere; for preview, use a placeholder)
vpc_id = "vpc-12345678"

db_instance = aws.rds.Instance(
    "app-db",
    identifier=f"app-db-{env}",
    engine="postgres",
    engine_version="15.0",
    instance_class=rds_instance_type,
    allocated_storage=20,
    db_name="appdb",
    username="appuser",
    password=config.require_secret("db_password"),
    multi_az=rds_multi_az,
    storage_encrypted=rds_encrypted,
    deletion_protection=True,
    backup_retention_period=7,
    publicly_accessible=False,
    db_subnet_group_name=db_subnet_group.name,
    vpc_security_group_ids=[db_security_group.id],
    skip_final_snapshot=True,
    final_snapshot_identifier=f"final-snap-app-db-{env}",
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Kubernetes Cluster (EKS)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
eks_vpc = aws.ec2.Vpc(
    "eks-vpc",
    cidr_block="10.0.0.0/16",
    enable_dns_support=True,
    enable_dns_hostnames=True,
)

eks_subnet_1 = aws.ec2.Subnet(
    "eks-subnet-1",
    vpc_id=eks_vpc.id,
    cidr_block="10.0.1.0/24",
    availability_zone="us-east-1a",
)

eks_subnet_2 = aws.ec2.Subnet(
    "eks-subnet-2",
    vpc_id=eks_vpc.id,
    cidr_block="10.0.2.0/24",
    availability_zone="us-east-1b",
)

eks_role = aws.iam.Role(
    "eks-role",
    name=f"eks-role-{env}",
    assume_role_policy=pulumi.Output.json.dumps({
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
            {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"Service": "eks.amazonaws.com"},
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
            }
        ],
    }),
)

aws.iam.RolePolicyAttachment(
    "eks-role-aws-eks-cluster-policy",
    role=eks_role.name,
    policy_arn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy",
)

eks_cluster = aws.eks.Cluster(
    "eks-cluster",
    name=f"eks-{env}",
    role_arn=eks_role.arn,
    vpc_config={
        "subnets": [eks_subnet_1.id, eks_subnet_2.id],
        "security_groups": [db_security_group.id],
    },
    version="1.28",
    enabled_cluster_log_types=["api", "authenticator"],
)

eks_node_role = aws.iam.Role(
    "eks-node-role",
    name=f"eks-node-role-{env}",
    assume_role_policy=pulumi.Output.json.dumps({
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
            {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
            }
        ],
    }),
)

aws.iam.RolePolicyAttachment(
    "eks-node-role-aws-eks-worker-policy",
    role=eks_node_role.name,
    policy_arn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy",
)

aws.iam.RolePolicyAttachment(
    "eks-node-role-aws-eks-cni-policy",
    role=eks_node_role.name,
    policy_arn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSCNIPolicy",
)

eks_node_group = aws.eks.NodeGroup(
    "eks-node-group",
    cluster_name=eks_cluster.name,
    node_role=eks_node_role.arn,
    subnets=[eks_subnet_1.id, eks_subnet_2.id],
    scaling_config={
        "desired_size": node_count,
        "min_size": 1,
        "max_size": node_count,
    },
    instance_types=[node_instance_type],
    disk_size=50,
    capacity_type="ON_DEMAND",
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load Balancer (ALB internal for dev, public for prod)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alb_security_group = aws.ec2.SecurityGroup(
    "alb-security-group",
    name=f"alb-sg-{env}",
    description="ALB security group",
    egress=[
        {
            "protocol": "-1",
            "from_port": 0,
            "to_port": 0,
            "cidr_blocks": ["0.0.0.0/0"],
        },
    ],
)

alb_security_group_ingress = aws.ec2.SecurityGroupIngress(
    "alb-security-group-ingress",
    security_group_id=alb_security_group.id,
    protocol="tcp",
    from_port=443,
    to_port=443,
    cidr_blocks=["0.0.0.0/0"],
)

# ALB does not exist in pulumi_aws as a single resource; use aws.lb.LoadBalancer
alb = aws.lb.LoadBalancer(
    "alb",
    name=f"alb-{env}",
    internal=alb_internal,
    load_balancer_type="application",
    security_groups=[alb_security_group.id],
    subnets=[eks_subnet_1.id, eks_subnet_2.id],
)

alb_listener_443 = aws.lb.Listener(
    "alb-listener-443",
    load_balancer_arn=alb.arn,
    port=443,
    protocol="HTTPS",
    ssl_policy="ELBSecurityPolicy-2016-08",
    certificates=[{
        "certificate_arn": "arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/example",
    }] if cloudfront_enabled else [],
    default_actions=[
        {
            "type": "forward",
            "target_group_arns": [],  # Will be set after target group creation
        },
    ],
)

alb_target_group = aws.lb.TargetGroup(
    "alb-target-group",
    name=f"alb-tg-{env}",
    port=80,
    protocol="HTTP",
    vpc_id=eks_vpc.id,
    target_type="ip",
    health_check={
        "enabled": True,
        "path": "/healthz",
        "port": "traffic-port",
        "protocol": "HTTP",
        "healthy_threshold": 2,
        "unhealthy_threshold": 3,
        "timeout": 5,
        "interval": 30,
    },
)

# Update listener to point to target group
alb_listener_443_options = aws.lb.ListenerDefaultAction(
    "alb-listener-default-action",
    listener_arn=alb_listener_443.arn,
    type="forward",
    target_group_arns=[alb_target_group.arn],
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CloudFront (prod only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if cloudfront_enabled:
    cloudfront_distribution = aws.cloudfront.Distribution(
        "cloudfront-dist",
        enabled=True,
        comment=f"CloudFront distribution for {env}",
        price_class="PriceClass_100",
        default_root_object="index.html",
        origins=[
            {
                "domain_name": alb.dns_name,
                "origin_id": "alb-origin",
            },
        ],
        default_cache_behavior={
            "target_origin_id": "alb-origin",
            "viewer_protocol_policy": "https-only",
            "allowed_methods": [
                "GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PUT", "PATCH", "POST", "DELETE",
            ],
            "cached_methods": ["GET", "HEAD"],
            "forwarded_values": {
                "query_string": True,
                "cookie": {
                    "forward": "all",
                },
            },
            "min_ttl": 0,
            "default_ttl": 3600,
            "max_ttl": 86400,
        },
        restrictions={
            "geo_restriction": {
                "restriction_type": "none",
            },
        },
        viewer_certificate={
            "cloudfront_default_certificate": False,
            "acm_certificate_arn": "arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/example",
        },
    )
    pulumi.export("cloudfront_domain", cloudfront_distribution.domain_name)
else:
    pulumi.export("alb_dns", alb.dns_name)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Secret (DB connection string) - using Pulumi ConfigSecret
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
db_password = config.require_secret("db_password")
db_conn_string = pulumi.secret(pulumi.interpolate.f"postgres://appuser:{db_password}@{db_instance.endpoint}:5432/appdb")

pulumi.export("db_connection_string_secret", db_conn_string)
```
